name: Hungary
currency_note: Hungary uses forint (HUF); the app shows euros. Tax figures below are in forint.

tax_year.return_due: NAV prepares a draft personal income tax return; you correct or accept it, and pay, by 20 May of the next year, after which the draft counts as filed.

summary: Capital income is taxed at a 15% personal income tax (szja). Many kinds also carry a 13% social contribution tax (szocho): interest in full, and dividends and certain capital gains until your total income reaches a yearly cap. Exchange trades through a supervised broker are taxed at 15% on the year's net result, and a long-term investment account (TBSZ) can make gains tax-free after five years.

topics.title: Profit when you sell
points: Trades in financial instruments made with or through a supervised investment firm in the EEA, the OECD or a tax-treaty country count as controlled capital-market transactions (ellenőrzött tőkepiaci ügylet), for example stock exchange sales. The year's gains and losses on these are netted and a net gain is taxed at 15%. NAV's list of income subject to the social contribution tax does not include this income.

Other sales of securities give a capital gain (árfolyamnyereség): the sale price minus the purchase price and related costs. It is taxed at 15%, plus the 13% social contribution tax until the yearly cap is reached.
A gain from selling investment fund units is treated as interest income (see Interest on savings).

figures.label: Social contribution tax on capital gains (until the cap)

topics.title: Dividends
points: Dividends are taxed at 15% personal income tax as the main rule.

Dividends also carry the 13% social contribution tax, but only until your total income for the year (wages plus the capital income on NAV's list) reaches 24 times the minimum wage: HUF 7,747,200 in 2026.

topics.title: Interest on savings
points: Interest is taxed at 15% personal income tax.

Since 1 July 2023 interest also carries the 13% social contribution tax, with no cap. It does not apply to deposits fixed or securities bought before that date, or to interest from real-estate fund units.
Interest on retail Hungarian government securities (lakossági állampapír) is not treated as taxable interest income.

topics.title: Funds and ETFs
points: The gain from selling units of an investment fund (kollektív befektetési értékpapír) is treated as interest income: 15% personal income tax, plus the 13% social contribution tax under the interest rules.

topics.title: Tax-free and tax-deferred accounts
points: Long-term investment account (tartós befektetési számla, TBSZ): money is locked in for a three-year period, which can be extended by two years.

Personal income tax on the yield: 0% at the end of the five-year period; 10% if the lock-in is not extended after three years or is broken during the two extra years; 15% if it is broken within the first three years.

For contracts made or renewed after 31 December 2024, the social contribution tax on the yield is 0% after five years, 8% after three to five years and 13% for under three years. TBSZ income does not count towards the social contribution tax cap.

figures.label: Personal income tax after 3 to 5 years
Social contribution tax after 3 to 5 years (contracts from 2025)

topics.title: Losses
points: A net loss on controlled capital-market transactions can be used through tax equalisation (adókiegyenlítés) against tax on such gains. Only losses from the tax year and the two years before count.
To use a loss in that year or the next two, show it in the return for the year it arose.

topics.title: Foreign shares
points: Capital gains made in a country with a tax treaty are taxable in Hungary at 15%.

Tax paid abroad on dividends can be deducted from the 15% Hungarian tax, up to the amount the treaty allows. If it is 15% or more, nothing more is due. Without a treaty, at least 5% must still be paid in Hungary.

topics.title: What your broker does and what you do
points: NAV prepares a draft return (adóbevallási tervezet) from the data it receives. If you do nothing by 20 May, the draft becomes your return.
Foreign dividends and foreign capital gains are declared in the return, together with any foreign tax paid that you want deducted.

dates.what: Last day to file the personal income tax return for the year before and pay the tax.

not_covered: Crypto (NAV's crypto page could not be read when this was checked).
Tax bills for 2027 that were before parliament in November 2026 were not reviewed for changes to capital income.
Pension savings accounts (NYESZ) and voluntary pension funds.
Securities lending, derivatives and business-owner dividends.
Real estate, and moving to or from Hungary.
